subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI realtime credential availability, or only after an explicit talk.realtime readiness/preflight says the provider is usable?
rationale: Current docs and code intentionally allow API-key/OAuth/Codex fallback, while this report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either direction changes user-facing setup semantics.

options.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
options.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog or an equivalent readiness result reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep Implicit Credential Activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex realtime auth as sufficient and narrow follow-up work to clearer diagnostics for provider/API failures.

options.title: Require Explicit Realtime Config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when talk.realtime is explicitly configured, accepting any upgrade or migration impact for existing users.

recommendation.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog or an equivalent readiness result reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The newest merged OpenAI Realtime auth fallback and docs change came from steipete, so this person is the best available owner for the credential/readiness product choice.
